verdict.rationale: Lever documents building custom, templatized dashboards in-app. Its developer API offers list endpoints (applications, deleted applications, audit events) and webhooks that let data be pulled out programmatically. This is a general data API rather than a purpose-built reporting or export pipeline. Missing for 10: scheduled report exports, native BI/warehouse connectors, a dedicated reporting/analytics API, and independent corroboration of extracting report data.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse
